profile.summary: mr21 is a mid-level JavaScript developer with deep expertise in jQuery's core functionality, particularly DOM manipulation, CSS property handling, and animation systems. Their contributions focus on fixing edge cases (e.g., handling `undefined` values in iteration), optimizing performance (e.g., byte-saving in utility functions), and refining jQuery's internal APIs. While their work is specialized in jQuery's legacy codebase, their debugging skills and attention to detail demonstrate a strong ability to tackle complex, low-level JavaScript issues. No evidence of modern JavaScript (ES6+) or backend development is present in their contributions.
